sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed with grievance that the petitioner, who is having a valid license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 for working as a whole-seller, distributor, retailer of meat, is not being permitted to carry on his business.

The petitioner's firm was granted License No.
12724998000377 dated 29.12.2024 by the Central Licensing Authority, New Delhi and the said license is valid upto 28.12.2025.
The petitioner has accordingly prayed for a direction to the respondent to decide his representation filed in this behalf.

2. Sri Rajeev Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel states that the petitioner in the instant case has a valid license under the Food Safety and Standards Act and District Magistrate has Mohd Shahrook vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 24 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158485190/
1 already passed an order on 30.4.2025 prohibiting SHOs' of all police stations from interfering in functioning of persons having valid license.
3.

entities.text: Mohd Shahrook vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner admits that since after filing of the writ petition, there has been no obstruction in carrying on of business by the petitioner.
4. In view of the above, cause of action does not survive any further.
5. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.

. 
(R.M.N. Mishra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 24.7.2025 Dhirendra/
